summary: Writes a per-session weather-conditions report to a text file. Opens the file for the config path (unk_5C2AB0), writes a header, then for each of 8 session types writes the session name and the per-session weather duration, simulates the weather transition in 10.0-unit steps via AudioADSREnvelope, and iterates a linked list of weather data points (nodes chained at +12) printing minute, condition, ambient and track temperatures. Ends the file, closes it and returns 0, or logs a failure via DebugLogWrite and returns -1.

operations.description: Open the output file for argument a2: sub_587DB0(a2, &unk_5C2AB0) returns a handle stored in v4.
Branch on the open result: nonzero handle proceeds to the write path, zero goes to the error path returning -1.
Write the aWeather header token to the file.
Write the asc_5C4060 separator/format token following the header.
Outer loop over the 8 session types: for (i = 0; i < 8; ++i).
Look up the session type name for index i via SessionTypeNameLookup(i, 0).
Write the aS_3 session-name token.
Write the asc_5D70F4 separator token after the session name.
Obtain the per-session weather duration v10 from sub_4FB910(i).
Reset the weather data iterator: this[14] = this[15] (current pointer set to the iterator start held in this[15]).
Weather transition simulation loop: start v9 at 0.0 and step by 10.0 while v9 < v10.
Each simulation step calls AudioADSREnvelope(this, 10.0, v9, 0) to advance the weather state by one 10.0-unit interval.
Write the aConditions2f conditions format token.
Write the aOnpathwetness2 on-path wetness format token.
Write the aOffpathwetness off-path wetness format token.
Write the aAmbienttemp2f ambient-temperature format token.
Write the aTracktemp2f track-temperature format token.
Load the first weather data point: v8 = *(float **)(this[14] + 12), reading the next-node pointer of the current iterator node.
Linked-list traversal: for (this[14] = v8; v8; this[14] = v8) walk the weather data points via the +12 next-node pointers.
Stop the traversal when (*v8 - v10) * 0.016666668 > 150.0, i.e. the point is more than 150.0 scaled time units past the session duration.
Write the aMinute2f minute format token for the current data point.
Write the asc_5D7070 separator token.
Write the aConditions2f_0 per-point conditions format token.
Write the aAmbienttemp2f_0 per-point ambient-temperature format token.
Write the asc_5D703C per-point separator token.
Advance to the next data point: v8 = *(float **)(this[14] + 12).
Write the asc_5D7038 token closing the per-session block.
Write the asc_5D7034 token closing the whole file.
Close the file via FileCloseWithLock(v4).
Return 0 on successful write.
Error path: if StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 1, aDDevF119992002_9, 2102) is nonzero, log via DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aCouldNotWriteT, a2).
Return -1 on file-open failure.
Invoked by sub_4FCAA0 as part of the weather-condition save path.
